_source: Records OpenBible.info keeps twice for one place under one name, merged into one (ADR 0022; pipeline/build_data.py, merge_aliases). The key is the retired record, `into` the place it is merged into: its verses join that place's, its id stays an alias of it (places.json `aliases`, ?place=, the old page redirects in apps/web/vercel.json). Merged only where all of these hold: the two stand on one point under one English name and one kind; STEPBible's TIPNR has them as one record; and the retired record's leading identification on OpenBible, held by more than half of its sources, is 'another name for' the other. The other same-name pairs on one point, and why they stay apart, are listed in docs/crosswalk/their-errors.md (item 17). Checked 2026-11-25.
